name: Shifting Loyalties
oracle_text: Exchange control of two target permanents that share a card type. (Artifact, creature, enchantment, land, and planeswalker are card types.)
flavor_text:
"Show the enemy the true path, and the spirit will yearn to follow it."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Lacerate Flesh
oracle_text: Lacerate Flesh deals 4 damage to target creature. Create a number of Blood tokens equal to the amount of excess damage dealt to that creature this way. (They're artifacts with "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

name: Overwhelming Victory
oracle_text: Overwhelming Victory deals 5 damage to target creature. Each creature you control gains trample and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the amount of excess damage dealt this way.
flavor_text: "Yes, we defeated you for all time. You will never rise from the ashes of your shame and humiliation!"

name: Wrath of the Skies
oracle_text: You get X {E} (energy counters), then you may pay any amount of {E}. Destroy each artifact, creature, and enchantment with mana value less than or equal to the amount of {E} paid this way.
flavor_text: Even the weather of Dominaria shifts to assail would-be invaders.

name: Orzhov Charm
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Return target creature you control and all Auras you control attached to it to their owner's hand.
• Destroy target creature and you lose life equal to its toughness.
• Return target creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

name: Self-Inflicted Wound
oracle_text: Target opponent sacrifices a green or white creature of their choice. If that player does, they lose 2 life.
flavor_text:
"Worse than watching the cruelest deed is watching it done by your own hand."
—Baihir, Dromoka mage

name: Splash Portal
oracle_text: Exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. If that creature is a Bird, Frog, Otter, or Rat, draw a card.
flavor_text:
"Don't ask me how it works. If I stopped long enough to question it, I'd lose my legs."
—Lorb, frogfolk wizard

name: Modify Memory
oracle_text: Exchange control of two target creatures controlled by different players. If you control neither creature, draw three cards.
set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
flavor_text: Percival's clothes itched and his dinner was unpleasantly wriggly, but the kobold looked like he was having the time of his life.

name: Hallowed Respite
oracle_text:
Exile target nonlegendary creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Otherwise, tap it.
Flashback {1}{W}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

name: Agonizing Demise
oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{R} (You may pay an additional {1}{R} as you cast this spell.)
Destroy target nonblack creature. It can't be regenerated. If this spell was kicked, Agonizing Demise deals damage equal to that creature's power to the creature's controller.
set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas

name: Mercy Killing
oracle_text: Target creature's controller sacrifices it, then creates X 1/1 green and white Elf Warrior creature tokens, where X is that creature's power.
flavor_text: "We will give you the peace you seek, though you may not yet know you seek it."

name: Orbital Plunge
oracle_text: Orbital Plunge deals 6 damage to target creature. If excess damage was dealt this way, create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
flavor_text: The Kav pilot gleefully ignored his lander's collision warning.

name: Torch the Witness
oracle_text: Torch the Witness deals twice X damage to target creature. If excess damage was dealt to that creature this way, investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
flavor_text:
"He was scheduled to meet me tomorrow with something important to share. This was no coincidence."
—Algrom of the Foundway Associates

name: Siren's Ruse
oracle_text: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. If a Pirate was exiled this way, draw a card.
flavor_text: Deception and misdirection are the heart of the pirate's arsenal.

name: Foul Renewal
oracle_text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the toughness of the card returned this way.
flavor_text: The cycle of life and death is rarely pretty.

name: Hell to Pay
oracle_text: Hell to Pay deals X damage to target creature. Create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to the amount of excess damage dealt to that creature this way.
flavor_text: For years afterward, lucky explorers who found the cave could chip gold fragments off the rocky walls.

name: Word of Blasting
oracle_text: Destroy target Wall. It can't be regenerated. Word of Blasting deals damage equal to that Wall's mana value to the Wall's controller.

name: Role Reversal
oracle_text: Exchange control of two target permanents that share a permanent type.
flavor_text: Uthlon the Wise scandalized sphinx society, hooting the answers to riddles as he rampaged through Tin Street. Grangle, on the other hand, sat for hours, deep in thought, largely ignored by fellow goblins.

name: Cling to Dust
oracle_text:
Exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a creature card, you gain 3 life. Otherwise, you draw a card.
Escape—{3}{B}, Exile five other cards from your graveyard. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost.)
flavor_text: In bleak Tizerus, all hope crumbles in your grasp.

name: Pyretic Rebirth
oracle_text: Return target artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Pyretic Rebirth deals damage equal to that card's mana value to up to one target creature or planeswalker.
flavor_text: Death has never kept Darigaaz down for long.

name: Carnivorous Canopy
oracle_text: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying. If that permanent's mana value was 3 or less, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

name: Break the Spell
oracle_text: Destroy target enchantment. If a permanent you controlled or a token was destroyed this way, draw a card.
flavor_text: As Hylda watched Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious form through the cold, Hylda felt something she hadn't felt in a long time: compassion.

name: What Must Be Done
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Let the World Burn — Destroy all artifacts and creatures.
• Release Juno — Return target historic permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it if it's a creature. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)

oracle_text: Exile target creature card from your graveyard. Create a black Zombie creature token. Its power is equal to that card's power and its toughness is equal to that card's toughness.
flavor_text: A mask forged to avenge a death forgotten.

name: Smashing Success
oracle_text: Destroy target artifact or land. If an artifact is destroyed this way, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

"Who said there's no profit in destruction?"

name: Kaervek's Purge
oracle_text: Destroy target creature with mana value X. If that creature dies this way, Kaervek's Purge deals damage equal to the creature's power to the creature's controller.

oracle_text:
Kicker {2}{W} (You may pay an additional {2}{W} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was kicked, you gain life equal to that card's mana value. Otherwise, you lose that much life.

—Genku, future shaper

—Sokka

flavor_text:

—Bo, Great Desert prospector
